description: Polish a photo with ServeReel Profile Polish on the connected account. Requires a connected ServeReel account (one-click sign-in).

comments.description: Anything specific to fix or keep, in plain words.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying so the polish is only started once.

image_base64.description: The photo as base64 data (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 20MB). Provide image_base64 or image_url.

image_url.description: A public http or https link to the photo.

style.description: Polish style. professional: clean professional headshot (default). executive, creative, casual, dating: matching looks. suit: suit and tie. nobg: background removed.

name: polish_photo
